title: Evaluation mate unchanged under simultaneous adjunction and tensor transport
statement: Let C and D be monoidal categories, H:C^{op} \times C \to C a functor, F:D\to C and R:C\to D functors, and p:F\dashv R an adjunction. Let t be a natural isomorphism F(A\otimes B)\cong F(A)\otimes F(B). Suppose e_{A,L,M}:Hom(A,H(L,M))\cong Hom(A\otimes L,M) is natural in A: e(a\circ g)=(a\otimes id_L)\circ e(g), writing composition in diagrammatic order. For an arbitrary natural automorphism \delta:F\cong F, put p'=p.ofNatIsoLeft(\delta) and t'_{A,B}=\delta^{-1}_{A\otimes B}\circ t_{A,B}\circ(\delta_A\otimes\delta_B), with composition still in diagrammatic order. For every L,M\in C, A\in D and \alpha:A\to R(H(L,M)), the evaluation mate p'.homEquiv(t'_{A,R(L)}\circ(id\otimes p'.counit_L)\circ e((p'.homEquiv)^{-1}(\alpha))) equals p.homEquiv(t_{A,R(L)}\circ(id\otimes p.counit_L)\circ e((p.homEquiv)^{-1}(\alpha))).

source.place: Tags 08I3 and 08I4, construction from evaluation and the adjunction counit; Tag 06YJ, derived-pullback presentation independence; formal transport calculation

proof.text: Mathlib Adjunction.homEquiv_ofNatIsoLeft_apply and homEquiv_ofNatIsoLeft_symm_apply express the transported equivalence and its inverse by precomposition with delta and delta inverse. The transported counit is delta inverse at R(L) followed by the original counit. Substitute these formulas into the evaluation mate.

Apply the assumed test-object naturality of e to move delta inverse at A through evaluation. Expand the transported tensorator. The input delta followed by delta inverse cancels. Merge the successive tensor morphisms by tensorHom_comp_tensorHom_assoc: the second factor cancels delta at R(L) with its inverse from the counit, and the first factor cancels delta at A with its inverse from evaluation. Iso identities and category identity laws give the original mate.

theorem internalHomMate_counit_transport
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (H : Cᵒᵖ × C ⥤ C) (F : D ⥤ C) (R : C ⥤ D) (p : F ⊣ R)
    (t : tensor D ⋙ F ≅ F.prod F ⋙ tensor C)
    (ex : ∀ A L M : C, (A ⟶ H.obj (op L, M)) ≃ (A ⊗ L ⟶ M))
    (hx : ∀ (A A' L M : C) (a : A' ⟶ A) (g : A ⟶ H.obj (op L, M)),
      ex A' L M (a ≫ g) = (a ⊗ₘ 𝟙 L) ≫ ex A L M g)
    (δ : F ≅ F) (L M : C) (A : D) (α : A ⟶ R.obj (H.obj (op L, M))) :
    let p' := p.ofNatIsoLeft δ
    let t' := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (tensor D) δ.symm ≪≫ t ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.prod δ δ) (tensor C)
    p'.homEquiv _ M (t'.hom.app (A, R.obj L) ≫
      (𝟙 _ ⊗ₘ p'.counit.app L) ≫ ex _ L M ((p'.homEquiv _ _).symm α)) =
    p.homEquiv _ M (t.hom.app (A, R.obj L) ≫
      (𝟙 _ ⊗ₘ p.counit.app L) ≫ ex _ L M ((p.homEquiv _ _).symm α))
